summary: Frontend-only verification of Order Manual E-Ticket revisions: (a) subtitle italic 'Jejak Langkah Sang Pelopor...' added under 'ASHIN JINARAKKHITA' in saveTicket canvas (verified in code lines 1511-1513), (b) clicking pembeli name in daftar order (desktop + mobile) auto-downloads e-ticket PNG same as tombol E-Ticket. Login admin1 -> Order Manual tab -> created order 'ZZ NAMECLICK TEST' (order 9232, seat M21). Tested downloads on desktop nameclick, desktop E-Ticket button, and mobile nameclick — all produced e-ticket-9232.png with 'E-ticket tersimpan sebagai gambar' toast. Deleted test order successfully. Regression: manual-amount and manual-paid remain absent (0 count). No fatal console errors (only unrelated CSP warnings for cloudflare beacon).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPage.js is 2854 lines — should be split into smaller focused modules (ManualOrderPanel, EticketRenderer, etc). File-size violates 700-line guideline.
saveTicket() text rendering does not sanitize/limit name length beyond .slice(0,40); consider similar wrap for very long names to avoid overflow off canvas.
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted test manual order 'ZZ NAMECLICK TEST' (order_no 9232, seat M21 Sesi 1). Data bersih setelah test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Order Manual E-Ticket flow confirmed working: subtitle in canvas + click-name auto-download for desktop (manual-nameclick-{order_no}) and mobile (manual-name-ticket-{order_no}). manual-ticket-{order_no} button still works. manual-amount & manual-paid absent from create form (regression OK). Login form uses placeholder='username' (no type=text).
